fieldValues.title: Most needs-input questions were already answered by principles
fieldValues.summary: Of 24 open needs-input issues on 2026-10-27, 6 were not questions (a wait or agent work), 15 were answerable from the charter, the ADRs and earlier rulings, and 3 were real questions. Builders stop at anything Door 2 or outside their mandate without first checking whether a principle already decides it. 12 of the 24 stopped this way.
fieldValues.body:
Not questions (should be blocked, parked or returned to an agent): srs-rust#1198, srs-rust#683, srs-rust#1339, muDemocracy.org#391, srs-rust#1132, srs-rust#1380.

Decided on principle the same day at the owner's instruction (vignette 431e12d6), each with a comment citing its rule: srs#236 (tighten names now), srs#244 (park), srs#911 (open the RFC), srs-rust#1184 (workflow_dispatch, no secret), srs-rust#1288 (render flag, not exportConfig), srs-rust#1289 (closed as done), srs-rust#861 (split A/B/C), srs-web#513 (narrowed), srs-web#562 (re-scoped), srs-programme#38 (a clerk command), clerk#25 (group cycle; judgement left pending).

Borderline, left for the owner: srs#928, srs-web#260, srs-web#567; srs-rust#1342 waits on proposed policy 84d873ce.

Real questions: srs-rust#1264 (axis 5-11 Reliability against axis 2-8 Evolution), srs#931 (identifier over label against reliability), srs#851 (RFC-050 acceptance, Door 2).

The six claims on needs-input issues were released the same day; srs-programme#189's answered question became a blocked-by edge on srs-rust#1473.
